title: Titanic · four-color ship and two masts
parts: One 269 mm Titanic: red lower hull, black upper hull, white decks, four orange funnels with black tops
Two separate orange masts laid flat; assembly required
material: PLA: red and black Bambu Basic; white and orange Clas Ohlson Universal / Generic PLA

snapshots.caption: Before start: entire textured plate viewed empty of print objects; pale prior outlines remain, plate seated.
During preparation: plate remains without model deposition, head above the bed. This is preparation evidence, not first-layer or finished-part evidence.

notes: Started exactly once after current human readiness and repaired orange-feed confirmation. Exact unique-file upload/readback SHA-256 and archive MD5 verified; fresh clear-bed camera, all four live PLA colors/profiles, AMS mapping and both 0.4 mm nozzles checked. Printer LAN address had changed; direct M4 connection authenticated the configured device. Previous Enigma job was terminal and its monitor stopped; controller ownership reconciled before start. SUCCESS acceptance matches new file, MD5, plate and sequence. Independent fresh RUNNING at layer 0/319, error 0, estimated 518 minutes remaining confirms preparation, not extrusion. Initial acceptance retained old layer 73 from Enigma before resetting to 0. Retained HMS notification 0500-0200-0003-000A has unknown text and unchanged timestamp predating the completed Enigma job; classification does not establish physical resolution. No error-clearing command was sent. Exact original reviewed 269 mm four-color ship and two flat orange masts reused; no reslicing. Red A1 / black A3 / white A2 / orange A4 map [0,2,1,3] to AMS0 physical0. PVA unused. First-layer adhesion, physical quality, fine details and mast fit remain unverified.
